name: Send Email Invitation
description: Sends an HTML email invitation to a party using the invitation.liquid template and logs the send event to the invitations collection. Triggered manually per party or as a bulk action. Skips parties who already have invitation_sent = true. Email is sourced from parties.representative.email.

name: Budget Payment Sync
description: Triggered when a vendor's status changes to 'paid'. Sums total_value across the vendor's contracts and adds that to the amount_paid field on the matching budget_categories record so you can track actual spend vs allocated.

name: RSVP Token Generation
description: Auto-generates a unique RSVP token for every new party record. The token is used to build the personalised RSVP link sent in email invitations.

name: RSVP Contact Details
description: Webhook — updates the representative's phone and email on the persons record after RSVP submission. Validates rsvp_token against the party and confirms the representative guest belongs to that party before patching.

name: RSVP Deadline: Mark Non-Responders
description: Runs daily on a schedule. Reads the rsvp_deadline from wedding_settings, and if it has passed, batch-updates all parties that have not yet confirmed or declined to status = 'no_response'. Safe to run repeatedly — already-marked parties are excluded from the filter.

name: Recessional Order Sync
description: Triggered whenever an entourage member's sequence_order (procession order) is created or updated. Recomputes all recessional_order values by inverting the procession sequence. The couple always exits first regardless of their sequence_order value.

name: Budget Allocation on Vendor Booking
description: Triggered when a vendor's status changes to 'booked'. Sums total_value across the vendor's contracts and allocates that amount to the matching budget_categories record, flagging is_over_budget if the effective ceiling (ceiling + contingency) is exceeded. Also handles the reverse when a vendor is cancelled.
